note: This file is a pure configuration file for the MMSegmentation framework. It contains no functions, classes, or callable APIs — only variable assignments defining dataset settings, data augmentation pipelines, dataloader configs, and evaluator configs for the Pascal Context (VOC2010) semantic segmentation dataset.
dataset_type: configures the PascalContextDataset type for semantic segmentation
train_pipeline: defines data augmentation steps including RandomResize, RandomCrop, RandomFlip, and PhotoMetricDistortion for training
test_pipeline: defines Resize and annotation loading steps for inference
train_dataloader: configures batch size, workers, sampler, and dataset path for training on Pascal Context
val_evaluator: configures IoUMetric with mIoU for validation and test evaluation
